decisions.reason: Automatic product-type assignment within TikTok does not necessarily change which products the tracking spreadsheet records or its current schema.
The source decision is explicitly limited to TikTok and does not alter publication to the Thai Market Finds website.
TikTok's automatic assignment of product type does not change CJ product selection criteria or the CJ import process.
Airbnb host outreach is unrelated to TikTok product-type assignment.
Daily social-content scheduling and publishing is unaffected by TikTok Shop catalog product-type assignment.
The content-bank deliverable is unrelated to TikTok Shop product-type assignment.
The completed Pinterest deliverable is unrelated to the TikTok Shop listing field behavior.
